name: Vall de Cardós (Spain)
description: Dark blue field with two white triangles in the lower corners forming a chevron, charged at the centre with a yellow bunch of three ears of wheat rising from an eagle's wings.
history: The official flag of Vall de Cardós is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, dark blue, with two white triangles in the lower part, the first with a leg of 1/2 of the height of the cloth at the hoist edge; approved by the municipal council on 19 June 2002 and published in the DOGC on 15 October 2002.

features.role: chevron formed by white triangles in the lower hoist and lower fly corners
three ears of wheat rising from wings
